subject: Request: revert billing model to committed usage + SOW segmentation addendum
messages:
From: Alex Rizzo <alex.rizzo@codahealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@codahealth.com
Date: 2026-08-16T16:22:00Z
Subject: Request: revert billing model to committed usage + SOW segmentation addendum

Hi Naomi —

Thanks again for the pilot support. We ran a cost review this morning and, given our finance constraints for H2, we need to move off the current value-based billing trial and back to a committed-usage model for production. Specifically: we want to convert the account to a 6‑month committed SKU with a monthly token commitment of ~120M tokens, effective Sept 1, 2026.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide a change order that (a) switches billing to committed usage, (b) updates pricing tiers to reflect committed discounts, and (c) includes an addendum to the SOW that maps our app environments to usage buckets (we can share mapping).
- We hit some unexpected Q2 overages while ramping the pilot — can we discuss a one‑time credit to cover excess usage (ballpark $8–12k)?

I attached our Q2 usage export and a marked-up SOW PDF to this message (CH_usage_q2.xlsx, draft_SOW_markup.pdf). Happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Alex Rizzo
Director, Platform Engineering
CodaHealth
alex.rizzo@codahealth.com
(415) 555‑0142

Attachments: CH_usage_q2.xlsx (spreadsheet), draft_SOW_markup.pdf (annotated PDF)

Thanks Alex — appreciate the clear ask and the attachments. Looping in Karthik (contracts/finance) and Laura (procurement ops) so we can coordinate the legal and billing side.

A couple quick clarifying items for the change order:
- Confirm the committed amount: 120M tokens/month for 6 months starting 2026-09-01 — is that final?
- For pricing tiers: do you want fixed unit pricing per token across the 6 months, or a stepped tier where higher consumption gets incremental discounts?
- Are you asking for a single one‑time credit covering Q2 overage (we'll need a supporting usage export and invoice numbers) — please confirm the desired credit amount or range.

If you can confirm those three points I will ask Legal to draft a change order + Exhibit B (SOW segmentation) redline. We typically prepare the change order and send via DocuSign; turnaround for standard redlines is 2–3 business days.

If useful, I can also schedule a 30‑minute call tomorrow to walk through the mapping and proration mechanics.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Subject: FW: Request: revert billing model to committed usage + SOW segmentation addendum

Karthik / Laura — forwarding CodaHealth's confirmed numbers and usage file. Proposed path and asks below; please treat as priority for a standard change order (we want to keep Sept 1 effective).

Proposed change order items (sales suggested):
1) Billing model: switch to 6‑month committed SKU
   - Commitment: 120,000,000 tokens/month, 2026-09-01 to 2027-02-28
   - Pricing: committed rate for 0–120M; stepped discount for 120M–200M; PAYG beyond 200M
2) SOW: add Exhibit B that maps CodaHealth environments to usage buckets (Segmentation mapping to be included verbatim from Coda markup)
3) Credit: one-time credit of $9,450 applied to next invoice to cover Q2 overage (invoice INV-CH-2026-0427) — sales recommends approving; finance please confirm budget/limits
4) Proration: first month (Sept) to be prorated to start date 2026-09-01; billing schedule monthly in advance per current order form

Immediate asks for Legal/Finance/Procurement:
- Karthik: please prepare redlines to the existing Order Form + new Exhibit B (use standard change order template). Flag any commercial/legal terms that need escalation (SLA, termination rights, indemnity carve-outs).
- Laura: confirm invoice to credit mapping and that procurement is OK with the proposed proration and credit flow.
- Ops: if either of you sees operational blockers (model variant pinning, region constraints) call out in the redline so we can include an implementation note.

Attachments included for the packet: Coda usage export (CH_usage_q2.xlsx) and Coda's annotated SOW (draft_SOW_markup.pdf). I also uploaded a first-pass redline skeleton: proposed_changeorder_redline.docx (attached).

If we can get legal redlines back by end of day Thursday (2026-08-19) I can route through DocuSign Friday and target signature early next week.

Thanks — Naomi
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
